title: HackerEarth: Monk and Inversions
description: Monk's teacher gave him an `M x M` matrix. An inversion occurs at two pairs `(i, j)` and `(p, q)` if `i <= p` and `j <= q` and `M[i][j] > M[p][q]`. Find the total number of inversions.
explanation: Iterates all subgrid quadrants (p >= i, q >= j) counting strictly greater elements in O(M^4) time.
